answer_1.quote: Graph-to-text generation is a challenging task that yields text from different graph structures and requires semantic alignment between graph and text.
answer_1.outputs: natural language text generated from knowledge graphs

answer_2.quote: Four popular metrics BLEU (B-4), METEOR (ME), CHRF++ (CF) and BartScore (BS) are adopted as evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: Two professional human annotators assess the quality of the generated graph-text pairs in PlanGTG.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to evaluate hallucination, missing information, grammatical correctness and fluency using a 5-point Likert scale.
